حننت (form I)
# حَنَنْتُ (ḥanantu) /ħa.nan.tu/: first-person singular past active of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# حَنَنْتَ (ḥananta) /ħa.nan.ta/: second-person masculine singular past active of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# حَنَنْتِ (ḥananti) /ħa.nan.ti/: second-person feminine singular past active of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# حُنِنْتُ (ḥunintu) /ħu.nin.tu/: first-person singular past passive of حَنَّ (ḥanna)
# حُنِنْتَ (ḥuninta) /ħu
